Methodology

Column: Kinetex XB-C18 (100 x 3.0 mm, 2.6 um). Mobile phase: Mobile Phase A: 0.1% formic acid in water; Mobile Phase B: Acetonitrile. The blue trace overlaid on each chromatogram below is %B (right-hand scale omitted, rescaled onto the signal axis).

Peak areas are considered from 5 min onward (the rt_start knit parameter – re-knit with a different value, e.g. rmarkdown::render("report.Rmd", params = list(rt_start = 8)), to change what’s included) through each injection’s own configured window end.
